errors.evidence: The description uses the incorrect term "пирограм" (pirogram) to describe the chart on the left. The correct Bulgarian term for a pie chart is "кръгова диаграма".
The description of the stacked bar chart on the right fails to mention the vertical axis, which shows a percentage scale from 0% to 100% with ticks every 20 percentage points.
The word "fosилни" is a misspelling of the Bulgarian word for fossil, which is "фосилни".
